name: @aimarkdown/mobile
description: AiMD mobile shell: one Capacitor app sharing the web renderer across Android, iOS and HarmonyOS.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @aimarkdown/web build && node scripts/copy-renderer.mjs && cap sync
scripts.build:apk: pnpm build:renderer && cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.build:ipa: node scripts/copy-renderer.mjs && cd ios/App && xcodebuild -project App.xcodeproj -scheme App -configuration Debug -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' -derivedDataPath ../../build/ios CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
scripts.build:hap: node scripts/copy-renderer.mjs && node scripts/sync-harmony-www.mjs && node scripts/check-harmony.mjs
scripts.test: echo 'mobile has no unit tests; see apps/web e2e for the responsive shell'
